decisions.reason: It is only mentioned on the website, so little is publicly committed, but the tooling for an agricultural niche crate is already sunk and one year is too early to rule out seasonal or temporary causes for weak results.
The foldable large container has its own page, fits the firm's announced reusable-logistics direction and carries substantial mould investment, so dropping it would write off visible commitment.
The stackable crate is a low-profile core-range item with modest visible commitment, but it is cheap to carry and too new to judge, so it is likely retained.
The medium-duty rackable pallet sits in the firm's core pallet business, and its tooling investment argues for persistence even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The spill-retention pallet has a dedicated page and supports the hygiene and safety positioning, so the public commitment and sunk development favour keeping it.
The pallet with load retainers is presented on its own page as an engineered solution, making it a visible commitment that management would justify by keeping it.
